title: Campaign 33 token C2_KCHK (class 2): prompts/33d R3 + 33e R2: the GPU Kraus check on IBM-T0 B0_ref117_k1 (I-ECHO); run 2 (default, --content cpu_only): Kraus and RM on the CPU in a separate process on the step's CPUs beside a 128-shot RM cuStateVec anchor, the four GPU arms read from run 1 (job 59780907, archived); raw counts; decides the class-2 representation

criteria.name: P0a run 1 archived byte-identically (sha256 of the archive = the harvested run 1's)
P0b run 1's GPU arms: the stored structure equals the one recomputed from their raw counts
criteria.threshold: sum of counts = shots_done and max |diff| <= 1e-12

criteria.name: K1 kraus_gpu_cusv (run 1) vs kraus_cpu (run 2): bug_confirmed iff |z_w| > 3 (both outcomes PASS; the field is the decision)
K2 production representation: rm iff rm_gpu_cusv (run 1) agrees with rm_cpu and kraus_cpu (run 2) (|z_w| <= 3, no marginal beyond 3 sigma), else blocked
K3 validated Kraus GPU path (run 1's native / cuStateVec-no-fusion arms vs kraus_cpu of run 2): first with |z_w| <= 3, else none

K4 the two CPU references agree (CI CPU arms vs the laptop's c33c_diag summary): |z_w| <= 3 per representation; recorded -- a disagreement is a STOP for the planner, not a token failure (prompts/33e R3 (b), section 2)
criteria.threshold: recorded (evaluated when the laptop summary is in the commit)

criteria.name: P0 raw counts of every run-2 arm stored (sum of counts = shots_done)
S1 the run happened on the requested device (GPU under the CI)
S2 wall time inside the walltime budget
criteria.threshold: <= min(walltime 3600 s, 3600 s) and <= 1.1 x budget + 120 s

criteria.name: S3 telemetry and run block present (policy fields non-null on the CI; run.cpu_affinity == SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK)
criteria.threshold: every policy field non-null on the CI and cpu_affinity == SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK there; present on the laptop

criteria.name: S4 every seed and every chunk recorded
S5 no out-of-memory retry left unrecorded

data.content: prompts/33d R3 + 33e R2: the GPU Kraus check on IBM-T0 B0_ref117_k1 (I-ECHO); run 2 (default, --content cpu_only): Kraus and RM on the CPU in a separate process on the step's CPUs beside a 128-shot RM cuStateVec anchor, the four GPU arms read from run 1 (job 59780907, archived); raw counts; decides the class-2 representation

seeds.rule: aer seed of chunk i of circuit c = s0 * 1e4 + c * 1e6 + i * stride, stride = chunk size, s0 = 33 000 000 + 1e5 x token index (prompts/33 2.3 s0; the circuit/chunk offsets are widened from 1e3 c so that circuits, chunks, tokens and the a/b halves are disjoint for <= 1e6 shots per circuit: the literal s0 + 1e3 c + i stride overlaps above 1000 shots per circuit).  prompts/33b R4: every part of a split class-4 run (part 1 on the F token, parts >= 2 on any C4_PART slot) uses s0 of the run's OWN F token, i = the chunk's index in the UNSPLIT chunk plan and stride = the sizing's chunk, so the parts concatenate to the unsplit run seed for seed and a slot can be re-used; the run's CV3 equal-shots sample uses the same s0 with circuit offsets 100 (k <= 4) / 200 (k = 5); an f-cell slot uses the slot's own s0 with circuit offset 4 x the cell's global index

supersedes.why: prompts/33e R2: run 1's GPU arms completed with raw counts (evidence of record, not repeated); its CPU arms drew 0 shots because the job step was bound to 1 CPU (R1: srun without --cpus-per-task); run 2 runs the CPU arms only

supersedes_decision_of.why: prompts/33d R5: C2_CAL run 3's P4a compared RM with the Kraus arm on the cuStateVec path, the execution under test; the C2_CAL JSON is not rewritten
